 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. We are officially halfway done with the 2026 NFL season.
 The NFL heads into Week 11, highlighted by the year's final international game: the Minnesota Vikings take on the San Francisco 49ers in Mexico City, Mexico, for "Sunday Night Football."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Indianapolis Colts and Houston Texans opened up the week on "Thursday Night Football," but quarterback Daniel Jones continued to struggle, completing just 44.4% of pass attempts for 144 yards and a pick. The Colts followed up with a statement move on Friday, announcing the team would release Jones and promote former No. 4 overall pick Anthony Richardson Sr. to the starting position in a stunning move.
 Los Angeles Rams receiver Puka Nacua might be done for the year after undergoing surgery on his MCL on Tuesday. Nacua was already on injured reserve with multiple injuries, but head coach Sean McVay says that he is now poised to miss "a couple months."
 That news came one day after Nacua was reportedly suspended three games by the NFL for violating the league's personal conduct policy, as a result of the receiver's series of incidents this offseason; Nacua is serving the suspension while on IR .
 The Detroit Lions will be without Aidan Hutchinson, who suffered a torn ACL during last week's win over the New England Patriots. New England will be without quarterback Drake Maye for the foreseeable future due to an ankle injury, though the extent of it — including how much time he will miss — has not been specified.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Philadelphia Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said that Joe Milton III will once again be under center as the team looks to shake its seven-game losing streak. Meanwhile, the Baltimore Ravens sent home Marlon Humphrey, ruling him inactive for this weekend as part of the fallout from his comments about "criminals" in Baltimore.
 Another injury to watch this week is Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield, who was spotted in a walking boot during the team's bye last week and could miss this week. This would pave the way for undrafted rookie QB Jalon Daniels to be back under center against the Lions.
 Follow along with Yahoo Sports for the latest NFL news, injury updates, and more.
 Live 64 updates Fri, Nov 20, 2026 06:09 PM UTC Kari Anderson Colts release QB Daniel Jones
 In a stunning move, Indianapolis has released starting quarterback Daniel Jones . Head coach Shane Steichen announced the news on Friday, adding that Anthony Richardson will be the team's new starting QB going forward.
 Fri, Nov 20, 2026 05:40 PM UTC Sean Leahy QB Carson Beck (back) not practicing, Josh Johnson could start for Cardinals
 After being limited in practice on Thursday, Cardinals quarterback Carson Beck will sit out Friday. Head coach Mike LaFleur said the team will prepare veteran Josh Johnson to start this week against the Chiefs.
 The 40-year-old Johnson made two starts last season with the Commanders. The Cardinals are his 15th NFL season.
 Fri, Nov 20, 2026 05:24 PM UTC Kari Anderson Baker Mayfield back in practice, trending towards starting on Sunday
 After sitting out practice earlier this week, Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is heading in the right direction to get back on the field on Sunday.
 Mayfield missed Wednesday's practice with injuries to his foot and right thumb, and was limited in practice on Thursday. Though Mayfield's designation for Friday isn't yet available, head coach Todd Bowles told reporters Friday that Mayfield looked good in practice and was trending in the right direction to start.
 Mayfield has been dealing with these injuries, but hasn't missed any time. Tampa Bay had a bye last weekend, giving their quarterback a bit more time to rest.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Fri, Nov 20, 2026 05:13 PM UTC Kari Anderson Puka Nacua may be out for season after undergoing MCL surgery
 The injury woes of Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua just got more severe: On Friday, head coach Sean McVay announced that Nacua had undergone surgery on his MCL on Tuesday, and that he'll be out for "a couple months." Timeline-wise, that might rule the receiver out for the rest of the season.
 Nacua was already on injured reserve with knee and turf toe injuries. He is also serving a three-game suspension for violating the league's personal conduct policy, with the suspension occurring while he's on IR.
 Fri, Nov 20, 2026 03:32 PM UTC Sean Leahy QB Geno Smith (ankle) to practice fully on Friday as Jets rule out 3 vs. Chargers
 Smith left Sunday's game after injuring his ankle. The quarterback has been limited this this week in practice, but will be a full participant on Friday, head coach Aaron Glenn said.
 Wide receivers Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip) and Isaiah Williams (ribs) have been ruled out. DT David Onyemata (abdomen), who had his 21-day practice window opened this week, will remain out.
 Fri, Nov 20, 2026 03:02 PM UTC Jeff Eisenberg 49ers and Vikings are preparing for Mexico City's thin air in very different ways. Science favors one
 As the 49ers practiced against the backdrop of the Rocky Mountains this week, the Vikings tried to bring Mexico City to the Midwest. They erected a massive altitude chamber at their Eagan practice facility that simulates the low-pressure environment found at elevations as high as 12,000 feet.
 Over the past five weeks, Vikings players have subjected themselves to aerobic workouts inside the chamber, using treadmills and stationary bikes to simulate the demands of exercising at altitude. The Vikings hope that altitude training inside their own building reduces the shock factor they experience Sunday night, Tyler Williams, the team's vice president of player health and performance, told reporters in Minnesota on Wednesday.

 Fri, Nov 20, 2026 02:15 PM UTC Ian Casselberry Aidan Hutchinson says his jumping celebration days are over after torn ACL: 'That's the last time I go airborne'
 In an Instagram post, the two-time Pro Bowl defensive end pledged to come back from his injury stronger than ever and to never again jump up to celebrate a big play.
 "I honestly can't believe it," Hutchinson wrote in his post. "I've jumped hundreds of times on a football field and never in a million years did I think this would happen to me. But even something like this won't hold me back." 
 "Two things I know for sure," he added. "1. I always come back stronger. 2. That's the last time I go airborne." 
 Hutchinson injured his knee on the Lions' first defensive series during their matchup in Munich with the New England Patriots on Sunday.
 Read more here .
 Fri, Nov 20, 2026 01:34 PM UTC Sean Leahy Bills to retire WR Andre Reed's No. 83 next season
 Reed played 15 of his 16 NFL seasons in Buffalo and was part of those Bills teams that reached four straight Super Bowls. Over 234 career games, he made 951 receptions for 13,198 yards and 87 touchdowns.
 The two-time All-Pro and seven-time Pro Bowler was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2014.
 Fri, Nov 20, 2026 01:27 PM UTC Eric Edholm After Thursday's loss, will Colts give Anthony Richardson another real shot?
 On Thursday, Richardson entered midway through the fourth quarter and missed his first two throws of the night. There was no second series; the Texans ran out the clock. And it almost feels like the Colts are trying to run out the clock on Richardson, Jones, Riley Leonard — all of it.
 Head coach Shane Steichen this week said he takes "everything into account" when it comes to the quarterbacks. He added: "Obviously, the biggest thing is taking care of the football moving forward."
 Asked about a potential QB change after Thursday's loss, Steichen said, "we'll evaluate everything."
 Read more here .

 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 08:33 PM UTC Kari Anderson Rams All-Pro WR Puka Nacua suspended 3 games for violating NFL's personal conduct policy
 Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua has been suspended for three games for violating the league's personal conduct policy, the NFL announced Thursday. ESPN's Adam Schefter was the first to report it .
 Nacua's suspension will go into effect immediately, and he will be eligible for reinstatement on Monday, Dec. 14. The All-Pro wideout is currently on injured reserve with knee and turf toe injuries sustained in Week 9's win over the Washington Commanders, and head coach Sean McVay has said he is expected to miss "significant time." If he were healthy by Dec. 14, he would not miss any additional time because of the suspension.
 Nacua's suspension comes following a roller coaster of an offseason, as he faced a civil lawsuit from a woman over an alleged biting incident and antisemitic comments earlier this year. An attorney representing Nacua denied the woman's claim that he made the antisemitic comment while downplaying the bite mark he left on her.
 Read more here. 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 08:15 PM UTC Sean Leahy Joe Burrow sick, Mike Evans back at practice
 The Bengals quarterback will not speak on his normal day as he is dealing with an illness, according to the team. If he's feeling better on Friday, he will meet with reporters. He did appear on the practice field and was seen throwing during the open portion, according to The Athletic's Paul Dehner Jr .
 The 49ers got a welcome sight on Thursday with wide receiver Mike Evans taking part in practice for the first time in a month. The 33-year-old has not played since Week 6 as he deals with an Achilles injury. San Francisco takes on the Vikings on Sunday night in Week 11.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 07:52 PM UTC Sean Leahy Raiders TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) back at practice
 After sitting out Wednesday, the Raiders tight end was back on the field for Thursday's practice. Klint Kubiak said earlier this week that Bowers is considered day-to-day as he deals with an ankle injury suffered during their Week 10 loss to the Seahawks.

 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 05:53 PM UTC Sean Leahy Cowboys DC Christian Parker talks coaching move
 Parker is remaining on as DC, but Mike Pettine will call plays on the defensive side of the ball.
 "A different perspective [will be] good for us," head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Wednesday . "Play-calling is a very collaborative thing."
 On Thursday, Parker addressed the change saying it's "not ideal" and did not comment directly when asked about his future in Dallas.
 When asked about his future with the Cowboys, Parkers left more up in the air: "We'll cross that bridge when we come to it."
 Read more here .
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 05:01 PM UTC Sean Leahy Broncos, CB Riley Moss reportedly finalizing 4-year, $67M extension
 Over four seasons in Denver, Moss has 196 total tackles and 3 interceptions. This season, the 26-year-old has 27 total tackle, 8 pass deflections and 1 interception through eight games.
 Moss was the Broncos' third-round pick in the 2023 NFL Draft.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 04:58 PM UTC Sean Leahy Ravens' CB Marlon Humphrey to be inactive vs. Panthers following Baltimore comments
 The Ravens have sent Humphrey home from the team facility on Thursday in the fallout from a joke about the city of Baltimore earlier this week, and he will be inactive for Week 11.
 During a segment on his podcast , Humphrey was asked what Baltimore was best at making. He first mentioned "The Star Spangled Banner" and National Bohemian beer, but then uttered a disparaging line that many have understandably found offensive.
 "What is Baltimore best at making?" Humphrey pondered . "They're best at making criminals."

 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 02:48 PM UTC Sean Leahy Injury updates on Baker Mayfield, Geno Smith and Kenneth Walker III
 Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield dealing with a foot strain and a thumb issue, did not practice on Wednesday. If Mayfield can't go against the Lions on Sunday, Jalon Daniels will get the call again.
 Geno Smith suffered an ankle injury on Sunday. He was limited during Wednesday's practice and the Jets believe the quarterback can start against the Chargers in Week 11.
 Groin tightness caused Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III to sit out Week 10. That allowed rookie Emmett Johnson to run wild against the Falcons. Walker sat out Wednesday's practice and looks unlikely to play against on Sunday. The team could be eyeing the Thanksgiving Day night game against the Bills for a return.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 02:30 PM UTC Jori Epstein As Cowboys strip Christian Parker of play-calling, Brian Schottenheimer asserts stakes: 'If we don't make the playoffs, it's a failure'
 It's a drastic shift from the confidence and excitement that surrounded the 34-year-old Parker coming out of training camp, when a highly vocal and schematically multiple group of defenders had Dallas brass wondering whether they could solve multi-year defensive woes.
 Parker has not fixed the Cowboys' defense as the unit ranks third-worst in points allowed per game (28.2) and worst in yards (393.8). But consider that last season's Cowboys ranked worst in points allowed and third-worst in yards a year after the Cowboys ranked second worst in points allowed and bottom-five in yards.
 The issues predate Parker. The fix remains elusive.

 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 02:14 PM UTC Sean Leahy 49ers WR Christian Kirk undergoes meniscus surgery
 Kirk was placed on injured reserve for the second time this season after missing the first six games due to a calf injury suffered during training camp. He was then put on IR on Nov. 8 with a knee injury after playing one game.
 The 49ers signed Kirk to a one-year, $6 million contract in the offseason.

 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 01:44 PM UTC Teddy Ricketson Cam Skattebo says he is retiring his backflip celebration after what happened to Aidan Hutchinson
 Detroit Lions defensive end Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL while celebrating a sack in the team's Week 10 win over the New England Patriots.
 Afterward, New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo told the New York Post's Ryan Dunleavy that the injury is making him rethink his celebrations.
 "It's hard to see," Skattebo told a couple of reporters after Monday's practice. "I'm saying yeah (no more). Mentally, I'm like, 'I'm not doing that.' That ain't going to happen to me." 
 Skattebo has become known for his backflip celebration. Even after dislocating his ankle and fracturing his tibia last year, he was seen still sporting his backflip celebration at a Fanatics Fest event over the summer that sent social media into a frenzy. While head coach John Harbaugh and general manager Joe Schoen spoke with him after that event, Skattebo said this decision to retire his backflip is his alone.

 Wed, Nov 18, 2026 09:19 PM UTC Andy Backstrom Although Bears don't practice Wednesday, team estimates RB Kyle Monangai, WR Luther Burden III would be full participants
 The Chicago Bears are coming off their bye and preparing for a Sunday matchup against the New Orleans Saints.
 Although the Bears didn't practice Wednesday, they released an estimated injury report for the day.
 On that report, running back Kyle Monangai and wide receiver Luther Burden III are both listed as full participants.
 Monangai hasn't played since Week 4. He's been out with turf toe and a thumb injury.
 Burden, meanwhile, has cleared concussion protocol after sustaining a helmet-to-helmet hit during the Bears' "Sunday Night Football" victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Nov. 8 in Week 9.
 That said, the Bears' estimated report includes defensive back Kyler Gordon (shoulder) as a DNP and defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons (knee) as a limited participant.
